svg.title: Visual servo aim error for all 60 real trials against distance from the arm base
svg.desc: Each vertical segment is one trial, from the first measured aim error to the last. Within 20 centimetres of the base 25 of 25 trials converged below 3 millimetres. Beyond 21 centimetres 3 of 24 did.
svg.text: Inside 20 cm the loop converged in 25 of 25 trials. Past 21 cm, in 3 of 24.
All 60 real trials. Each segment runs from the first measured aim error to the last, before the jaws descend.
Object distance from the arm base
Reliable zone: the marker tracks the jaws
